A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''officer''' with the rank of [[Lieutenant Commander/Legends|lieutenant commander]] served aboard the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], during the [[Starship/Legends|ship's]] murder investigation of the [[Death/Legends|death]] of Lieutenant Commander [[Tanith Sorn]]. This officer was responsible for issuing orders, passed down by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], to a team of six ''Executor'' crewmen to investigate the crime and bring the perpetrator to justice.
